answer.main_body: synagogue / gatehouse with turquoise dome and flat roof terrace
answer.evidence: The structure clearly depicts a flat rooftop terrace spanning rows 8 to 55 (complete with top-down placed urns, a hatch door, and parapet walls) behind and above the lower brick facade, plus a foreshortened tiled lintel above the archway (rows 52-54).

answer.main_body: assembly hall with dome and arched portal
answer.evidence: The building features a large accessible flat rooftop terrace (rows 6-54) viewed from above with props (pots, roof hatch) resting on it, and the dome displays downward-curving latitude lines and an elliptical drum base typical of a 3/4 top-down view.

answer.main_body: domed building with rooftop terrace and arched gate
answer.evidence: The building clearly shows its top horizontal roof terrace spanning rows 8 to 55 complete with rooftop urns and a hatch, with the front south facade below from row 56 to 95. The dome and its drum also correctly show 3/4 downward projection.

answer.main_body: synagogue/mosque structure with dome, gatehouse portal, and rooftop terrace
answer.evidence: The structure clearly shows its expansive horizontal roof terrace (rows 8–54) seen from above at a 3/4 perspective, complete with jars and a hatch resting on the surface. The dome base (rows 26–34) also curves downward in proper foreshortened perspective above the lower vertical facade.
